name: @lokiai/native-credential-store
description: LokiAI Main v1.2 shared native Node addon wrapper (P1-NODE-IPC-CLIENT-001, ADR-0009): read-only, purpose-bound Windows-DPAPI credential decryption for the Node IPC client. Wraps the compiled crates/loki-credential-native cdylib; never mints a credential, never exposes plaintext outside an in-process Buffer.
